Cite only prefixes actually supplied here; do not invent or infer a prefix for an unseen window. This names a correction target in the new parent summary; it does not rewrite or link separately sealed siblings that are absent from this input. Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no markdown fences:
{"summary": "2-3 first-person sentences on outcomes: what I did, decided, learned, and left open, naming people, artifacts, and threads.
